title: Lights out: the bedside robot arm takes your phone
summary: You're scrolling in bed late at night when a robot arm on the nightstand reaches over, takes your phone and tucks it away.
why: AI Trend Club lists a bedtime robot clip traced to a TikTok post from November 20, 2026, with about 17K views when it checked on November 22. It's a small, new trend and an easy, relatable joke about late-night scrolling. We haven't covered it before.
steps: Pick a clear photo of your face and shoulders.
Paste the main prompt into an image-to-video tool with your photo.
Keep it to about 6 seconds and add a caption like "me at 1 a.m.".
Say it's made with AI in your caption.

prompts.label: Main prompt: the phone grab
prompts.text: Use the person in this photo. Keep their face, hairstyle, hair colour and skin tone the same. Make a 6-second vertical clip in a dim bedroom at night. They lie in bed under a duvet, in pyjamas, face lit by the glow of the phone they're holding. A small white robot arm sits on the nightstand next to a warm lamp. Seconds 0 to 2: they keep scrolling, eyes heavy. Seconds 2 to 4: the robot arm turns, reaches over and gently takes the phone out of their hand. Seconds 4 to 6: the arm sets the phone face down in a drawer, closes it and switches off the lamp. They stare at the ceiling in shock. Steady camera from the foot of the bed. No text on screen, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation: the arm tucks you in
prompts.text: Use the person in this photo. Keep their face and hairstyle the same. Make a 6-second vertical clip in a cosy bedroom at night. They're scrolling in bed. A small white robot arm on the nightstand takes the phone, drops it in a basket, then pulls the duvet up to their chin and pats their head twice. They give up and close their eyes. Warm lamp light, steady camera. No text, no logos.

prompts.label: Variation for a small business: closing time
prompts.text: Use the person in this photo. Keep their face and hairstyle the same. Make a 6-second vertical clip in a small shop after closing, lights low. They sit behind the counter checking their phone. A small white robot arm on the counter reaches over, takes the phone, sets it down and flips a sign on the counter that reads "Closed. See you at [opening time]!". They laugh and put on their coat. Steady camera. No other text, no logos.

tips: Ask for a "small white robot arm" so it looks friendly, not scary.
A dark room with one lamp and the phone glow sells the late-night mood.
Keep the clip short. The joke lands in the grab.
Say it's made with AI in your caption.
